data.title: 玛露希尔 · 魔物料理的真香现场
data.description: 迷宫营地的锅前，她从「绝对不吃魔物！」的激烈抗拒到小心翼翼地尝一口，再到捧着碗追加第二碗——三个阶段表情变化是这个角色的灵魂三连。

data.camera: three-panel horizontal triptych, medium shot in each panel
data.promptProse: Show Marcille Donato in three horizontal panels beside the same dungeon cooking pot: she first leans away with an open palm and firm refusal, then cautiously tastes one spoonful, finally extending an empty bowl for another helping with an embarrassed smile. Each panel contains her once in the same blue robe, cream tunic and blonde braids. Campfire light warms faces, bowls and stone surfaces; repeated pot shadows connect the successive moments.
